authoring: blind — authored from clone reads only, no retrieval run; every expect clause grep-verified (whitespace-normalized substring) in the named file; corpus is corpus-dailymed @21a87b3cbed4 (first 1,000 SPLs)

dailymed.shape_risk: The corpus is 18,729 section files in which one drug recurs as many near-identical generic labels: carbamazepine spans 309 files across 79 SETIDs, tadalafil 291 files across 12 SETIDs, metformin 193 across 23, tamsulosin 87 across 8, so a query can retrieve the right drug from the wrong label and still miss the graded span. Measured on this suite's expects: the tadalafil nitrate guidance 'before nitrate administration is considered' occurs in 16 files but the exact 19-word expect in only 6 files across 4 SETIDs (the other 10 reword it), the metformin expect span is verbatim-duplicated in exactly 2 of 193 metformin files, and 'intraoperative floppy iris' appears in 11 files across 4 tamsulosin SETIDs while the patient-information phrasing used as expect is unique to 1 of 87 tamsulosin files. Brand labels invert the hazard — ELIQUIS is a single SETID (76 files) and its 24-hour epidural-catheter sentence and the Tyrvaya dry-eye sentence are each verbatim-unique to 1 file, so difficulty there comes from paraphrase distance, not sibling crowding.

queries.q: The eye doctor gave me a Tyrvaya nasal spray — what condition is it actually supposed to treat?
queries.expect: nasal spray is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease

queries.q: Is it okay to split or chew my metformin extended-release tablet if it's hard to swallow?
queries.expect: Swallow metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets whole and never crush, cut or chew.

queries.q: Someone on Eliquis still has an epidural catheter in after surgery — how long after their last dose can it come out?
queries.expect: Indwelling epidural or intrathecal catheters should not be removed earlier than 24 hours after the last administration of ELIQUIS.

queries.q: My husband took a tadalafil tablet and now has bad chest pain — how long do we have to wait before giving nitroglycerin?
queries.expect: at least 48 hours should have elapsed after the last dose of tadalafil tablets before nitrate administration is considered

queries.q: I've been on tamsulosin for my prostate for years and I'm having cataract surgery next month — what should I warn the eye surgeon about?
queries.expect: a condition called intraoperative floppy iris syndrome (IFIS) can happen if you take or have taken tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules
